en.askTitle: Swap in your own dates, budget and hotels to get a Kansai plan checked the same way
en.runTitle: Singapore couple, 3–9 April 2027: six days around Osaka and Kyoto on about SGD 3,200 excluding flights

fields.label: Travellers and passport nationalities
fields.value: A couple in their late 30s, Singaporean

fields.label: Dates and flight times
fields.value: Fly into Kansai Airport on Saturday 3 April 2027, out on Friday 9 April 2027

fields.label: Budget and flight exclusions
fields.value: About SGD 3,200 for two, excluding flights

fields.label: Walking needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. no more than 10,000 steps a day, no steep hill climbs

fields.label: Hotel quotes
fields.placeholder: e.g. a Namba hotel at SGD 190 a night for six nights

en.template: Plan Kansai for {who} on {dates}, with {budget}, {walking} and {hotels}. Compare one Namba base with a simple Osaka–Kyoto split, keep early Kyoto visits and a slower day trip, and include early/late-blossom and rain swaps. Verify all-in room costs, current fares/pass validity and entry rules for my dates. Separate historical samples, estimates and confirmed quotes. Plan only; do not book, contact anyone, create accounts or pay.

phases.title: Check transport, sights, blossom timing and entry rules on official sites
phases.note: Sight fees and hours, cherry blossom forecast, entry rules for Singapore passports
phases.judgment: It caught an outdated price: Ginkakuji now charges ¥1,000 for adults (it was ¥500 until 1 April 2026), so the old figure was not used. It also would not promise Kiyomizudera’s evening opening, because the temple’s timetable only covers 2026.

phases.title: Look at hotel price examples and work out the route and a budget that adds up
phases.note: Namba base against an Osaka and Kyoto split, with dated hotel prices

phases.title: Write the itinerary and sources, and check fares against each operator
phases.judgment: For fares it went to the operators’ own pages: Hankyu’s official calculator gives ¥410 from Osaka-Umeda to Kyoto-Kawaramachi, not ¥430, and it checked this for 5 April 2027 too. Fares it could not confirm, such as the Nankai airport fare and one Metro fare, are marked provisional.

workers: Checked entry fees and opening hours for the Osaka, Kyoto, Nara and Uji sights on the route, and the cherry blossom outlook
Looked for publicly shown prices at two hotels each near Namba and Kyoto Station, noting the stay dates, taxes, breakfast and cancellation terms
Checked train fares and journey times on each railway’s own site, and compared rail passes with paying per ride

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的日期、预算和酒店，就能得到同样核实过的关西行程
zh.runTitle: 新加坡夫妻，2027 年 4 月 3 日至 9 日：大阪京都六天，预算约 3,200 新元（不含机票）

fields.label: 人数及护照国籍
fields.value: 一对夫妻，三十多岁后段，新加坡籍

fields.label: 日期和航班时间
fields.value: 2027 年 4 月 3 日（周六）飞入关西机场，4 月 9 日（周五）离开

fields.label: 预算及机票是否另计
fields.value: 约 3,200 新元（两人），机票另计

fields.label: 步行需求
fields.placeholder: 例如：每天不超过 10,000 步，不爬陡坡

fields.label: 酒店报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：难波一家酒店每晚 190 新元，住六晚

zh.template: 请按{who}、{dates}、{budget}、{walking}和{hotels}规划关西。比较难波一处住宿与简单的大阪京都分住，保留京都早晨及慢一点的近郊日，并安排早花、晚花和雨天互换。核实实际日期的完整房费、票价、通票有效期及入境规定，分清历史示例、估算和确认报价。只做规划，不预订、不联系、不开户、不付款。

phases.title: 在官方网站核实交通、景点、花期和入境规定
phases.note: 景点票价与开放时间、樱花预报、新加坡护照入境规定
phases.judgment: 它挑出了一个过时的价格：银阁寺成人票现在是 1,000 日元（2026 年 4 月 1 日前是 500 日元），旧数字没有被采用；清水寺的夜间开放也没有承诺，因为寺方的时间表只覆盖 2026 年。

phases.title: 看酒店价格示例，排出路线并算出合得上的预算
phases.note: 难波一处住宿对比大阪京都分住，酒店价格带日期

phases.title: 写出行程和来源，并逐家核对各铁路公司的票价
phases.judgment: 票价直接查各公司官网：阪急官方计算器显示大阪梅田到京都河原町是 410 日元而不是 430 日元，并且按 2027 年 4 月 5 日也查过。没能确认的票价（南海机场线和一段地铁）都标成了暂定。

workers: 核实路线上大阪、京都、奈良和宇治各景点的门票与开放时间，以及樱花花期预期
在难波和京都站附近各找两家酒店的公开价格，记下入住日期、税费、早餐和取消条件
在各铁路公司官网核对票价和乘车时间，并比较通票与按次付费
